terms.meaning: A script that changes the database structure in a fixed, repeatable order.
A database rule that limits each user to the rows that belong to them.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Migration header
sections.what: Describes the file as the first database setup for Momentum OS, which turns on row-level security for every table tied to a user.
sections.why: Likely reason: tells future readers the purpose of the script.
sections.watch_out: The header promises security on every table, so check each table block to confirm it.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: User profile table
sections.what: Stores one profile row per account, with level, experience, coins, streak, freeze tokens, momentum score and enabled modules. Row-level security is turned on so each user sees only their own row.
sections.why: Likely reason: one profile per login account, so a profile is removed when its account is removed.
sections.watch_out: The app's profile also tracks last active date, weekly history and GPA goal, and this table has no columns for them, so those values are not stored here.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Projects table
sections.what: Stores each project's name, color, icon, progress, risk level, velocity and burndown points, tied to one user.
sections.why: Likely reason: each kind of item gets its own table, and a user column keeps each person's items private.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code does not read projects back from this table, so changes saved here will not appear in the app.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Tasks table
sections.what: Stores each task with its status, priority, energy level, due date, time estimate, subtasks, tags and dependencies.
sections.why: Likely reason: tasks are the main item sent to the cloud, so this table holds the most detail.
sections.watch_out: Due dates and times are plain text rather than date values, so sorting and date comparisons must be handled with care.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Habits table
sections.what: Stores habit details, streak numbers, success and miss percentages, and a day-by-day history.
sections.why: Likely reason: a habit's full history sits on one row so it can be shown without extra lookups.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code does not send habit changes to this table, so the table may not match what the user sees.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Daily routines table
sections.what: Stores routines with their checklist items, time of day, and whether they are finished today.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The done-today flag is stored here, but this file does not reset it each day, so that reset must happen in the app.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Notes table
sections.what: Stores a note's title, text, tags, links to other notes, folder and mood.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code does not sync notes to this table, so it is not yet used by the app.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Calendar entries table
sections.what: Stores calendar entries with start and end times as text and an optional link to a task.
sections.why: Likely reason: several parts of the app create calendar entries automatically from tasks, internships and assignments.
sections.watch_out: Start and end times are required, so a calendar entry saved without them will be rejected by the database.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Focus session history table
sections.what: Records each finished focus session with its length, mode, task title and tree type.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps a history of finished focus time for later statistics.
sections.watch_out: Length and mode are required, so a session missing either will be rejected.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Courses table
sections.what: Stores each course's code, name, credits, grade, professor and attendance percent.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code saves courses only locally, so this table is not filled by the app yet.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Assignments table
sections.what: Stores assignment details, the course it belongs to, due date, status, weight and grade.
sections.why: Likely reason: tracks coursework and grades for the academic part of the app.
sections.watch_out: A course link and due date are required, and the store's add action does not check for them, so an assignment missing either will fail to save.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Internships table
sections.what: Stores company, role, status, application date, deadline, pay, location, and resume and portfolio links.
sections.why: Likely reason: supports tracking job and internship applications.
sections.watch_out: Company, role and application date are required, and the store's add action does not check for them.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Hackathons table
sections.what: Stores hackathon details including start and end dates, team, tech stack, prize and progress.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Start and end dates are both required, and the store's add action never sets an end date.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Competitions table
sections.what: Stores a competition's title, platform, date, rank and score.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Title, platform and date are required, and the visible store code does not save competitions here.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Research papers table
sections.what: Stores a paper's title, journal, submission date, status, co-authors and link.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code does not save research papers to this table.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Certifications table
sections.what: Stores a certificate's name, issuer, issue date, credential link and skills.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The visible store code does not save certifications to this table.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Goals table
sections.what: Stores goal details including vision, reason, time frame, target date, milestones, reward and linked projects.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: A target date is required, and the store's add action does not check for it.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Achievements table
sections.what: Stores an achievement's title, description, icon, unlocked flag, unlock time and reward XP.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Title, description and icon are required, and the visible store code never writes to this table.

sections.name: CREATE
sections.title: Notifications table
sections.what: Stores alerts with a title, message, time, read flag and type.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The mark-as-read and clear actions in the store do not change this table, so read status is not saved.

summary: A database setup script that creates the cloud tables for Momentum OS and turns on row-level security.
purpose: Creates the cloud storage structure so signed-in users can save their data.
why: Likely reason: a migration file records each change to the cloud database in order.
how: 1) Adds a header describing the purpose. 2) Creates one table per data area in later blocks. 3) Turns on row-level security so users can only see their own rows.
inputs: Run against the Supabase database, usually by its migration tool.
outputs: New tables and security rules in the cloud database.
risks: Only the header was visible here, so the table definitions and security rules could not be checked. A missing or wrong rule could expose one user's data to another.
debug: If saves fail with a permission error, check the row-level security rules for that table. If a table is missing, check that this migration has been applied.
